notes: Finished guns no longer use Mk/rating/tier presentation anywhere.
Canonical DONE weapon migration deletes stale mk, rating, tier, ratingLabel, and marketTier flags from world and actor-owned weapon copies.
Weapon vendor progression now uses a hidden marketBand field only for vendor-quality gating; marketBand is not presented as a weapon stat.
ADK Market weapon cards are tagged separately and their Mk badge is hidden completely.
Mk filter chips no longer filter weapon results because guns are not Mk equipment.
Armor, grenades, consumables, Quickhacks, and other Mk-based equipment retain their existing Mk behavior.
Market stock patch version 1.1.0 re-patches the world Market macro and resets saved vendor stock once so open shops immediately reflect the Mk-free weapon behavior.
